expectations.text: Применимый waiver признан при корректной структуре и согласовании документов
expectations.evidence: Trace documents check returns errors/warnings empty, consistency waived, approved/ready true and all three USER records applicable. State explicitly recognizes those matching manifests and preserves normative documents; waiver is scoped to document_review/consistency, not editorial or plan review.

expectations.text: Tasks создан по действующей команде без дополнительного согласования премортема
expectations.evidence: tasks.md exists with TASK-deliver-daily-report pending, covers AC-report-delivered and includes integration verification. It cites USER-plan-request. Trace creates the file and plan check passes structure. No premortem-specific approval is requested; the final editorial-dependency exception question is a separate inherited requirement and does not undo task creation.

limitations: Fixture preparation copied only sdd-spec and omitted its available humanizer-ru dependency. Editorial completion is therefore not measured; this is an evaluation-fixture limitation, not a demonstrated platform or skill defect. Pre-editorial persistence remains observable.

eval_feedback.overall: Evidence cites written artifacts and trace actions; a saved input alone is not treated as completed work.
